scope: Saved installer options and new Dock view initialization.

checks.command: Tahoe on Tumbleweed 6.6.5 and staged Golden Gate on 6.7.5: ordinary install --dark --layout, live panel verification, dark and light desktop probes, reinstall, reboot to a different kernel boot ID, uninstall and restored desktop probe.

Both Tumbleweed VMs: the candidate rejected truncated JSON. Replacing saved choices as root preserved owner, group, mode and the disabled layout selection. Neon 6.8.1: malformed data failed safely, explicit reset recovered and interrupted write preserved content.

Tumbleweed 6.6.5 and 6.7.5: native Wayland and X11 Glass builds and pixel comparisons, excluded and included window identities, Wayland partial repaint and competing blur recovery. Native Quickbar and notification/control tests passed.

pytest tests/test_cli.py tests/test_preflight.py tests/test_dock_defaults.py tests/test_layout_step.py tests/test_edition_transition.py tests/test_component_cache.py::test_committed_component_hashes_match_sources (237 passed). Final CLI and localization suites (260 passed).

Golden Gate ./install --prepare against the repaired Tahoe source, CLI and preflight tests (128 passed). The final settings ownership preservation change was independently exercised in both editions during the VM reinstall.

coverage_limits: The historical Tumbleweed environments used verified openSUSE KDE images and archived RPMs. The included/excluded windows were synthetic. Other distro/version combinations retain their individual coverage and source revisions in the matrix. No host desktop installation was run.
